infoPlist.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: JoyoFit uses Bluetooth to connect to your Huawei or Honor watch and sync its data.
infoPlist.NSBluetoothPeripheralUsageDescription: JoyoFit uses Bluetooth to connect to your Huawei or Honor watch and sync its data.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: JoyoFit uses your location to look up the weather for your area (only coordinates rounded to about 1 km go to the weather service, Open-Meteo) and to send your position to your watch while a workout you started on the watch is running. Nothing else leaves your phone.
infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: JoyoFit does not read your Apple Health data. It only writes the data recorded by your watch.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Allow JoyoFit to save the steps, distance, calories, heart rate, blood oxygen, sleep, workouts and workout routes recorded by your watch to Apple Health.

plugins.photosPermission: JoyoFit reads a photo only when you pick one, for a watch face or for the image of a workout you share.
plugins.cameraPermission: JoyoFit uses the camera only when you take a photo to put behind the numbers of a workout you share.
